description: Source code for the DeviceInfo plugin in WPEFramework, implementing system information retrieval and response handling.

classes.name: DeviceInfo
classes.description: Class implementing device information service, including initialization, request processing, and system info retrieval.

methods.name: DeviceInfo::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the device info service, setting up system and subsystem references.

methods.name: DeviceInfo::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and references during deinitialization.

methods.name: DeviceInfo::Information
methods.description: Returns additional device info; currently empty.

methods.name: DeviceInfo::Process
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests, returning system info in JSON format for GET requests.

methods.name: DeviceInfo::SysInfo
methods.description: Populates system information data structure with current system metrics.

methods.name: DeviceInfo::AddressInfo
methods.description: Gathers network interface addresses and MAC addresses.
